title: Intermittent broadband connection checks
content: Check for an area notice, then inspect the line-status light and securely reseat cables. Restart the router once. Record exact drop times and line diagnostics before escalating a recurring fault.

title: Evening line drops escalation
content: When a fixed-line connection fails repeatedly at similar times, collect dates, times, router status, and service address through approved channels. Request a line-quality investigation rather than repeating restarts.

title: Broadband speed troubleshooting
content: Compare the subscribed plan with a wired speed test near the router. Pause other heavy traffic and repeat tests at different times. Escalate consistently low wired results with timestamps.

title: Wi-Fi versus line speed
content: A slow Wi-Fi test alone does not prove a line fault. Compare wired and wireless results, distance from the router, and device load before requesting network diagnostics.

title: Router light and power checks
content: Verify the power adapter, outlet, and cable connections. Note the status lights, then restart the router once. Repeated power loss or reboot loops require a hardware assessment.

title: Router replacement eligibility
content: If basic power checks fail, confirm device ownership, warranty, and replacement policy before arranging a swap. Do not promise a free replacement before eligibility is checked.

title: Unexpected invoice charge review
content: Compare current and prior invoices, plan-change dates, add-ons, and usage. Explain each charge from the billing record. Escalate an unresolved discrepancy with a review reference.

title: Disputed charges and adjustments
content: Do not assume a charge is wrong or promise a credit. Document the disputed line item and route it through the billing-adjustment process after checking the account ledger.

title: Missing postpaid payment
content: Use the payment reference, date, and amount to check the ledger. If the bank shows a settled payment absent from the account, open a trace. Do not ask for full card numbers.

title: Duplicate payment review
content: Compare transaction references before asking the customer to pay again. A possible duplicate debit should be sent for payment review with the relevant dates and amounts.

title: New SIM activation checks
content: Confirm the activation request and identity verification status through approved systems. Ask for one device restart and check that the SIM is seated properly. Escalate a pending activation beyond its communicated window.

title: Replacement SIM not provisioned
content: Check whether the replacement SIM is mapped to the account and whether activation completed. Do not request identity documents or one-time codes in chat; use the approved verification flow.

title: Mobile calling failure checks
content: Check for an area network notice and account restrictions. Ask the customer to toggle airplane mode and restart once. Compare behavior across locations before escalating with time and location.

title: Dropped calls in several locations
content: Record the affected locations, times, device type, and whether another handset shows the same issue. Send persistent or widespread calling faults to network support.

title: Mobile data unavailable
content: Confirm mobile data is enabled and the plan has remaining allowance. Check network notices and the device network mode. Use official APN instructions if calls work but data does not.

title: 5G icon with no data
content: A 5G indicator does not confirm usable data. Compare another location or network mode, verify plan allowance, and escalate persistent failures with device model and time.

title: Roaming service setup
content: Check destination coverage, plan entitlement, account roaming status, device setting, and partner-network selection. Explain charges before any paid change.

title: Roaming escalation details
content: For an unresolved travel-service failure, collect country, partner network, time, and whether voice or data is affected. Route the case to roaming support without promising immediate restoration.

title: Missing prepaid recharge
content: Confirm transaction reference, amount, destination number, and current balance. If the payment settled but credit is absent, start a recharge trace and discourage a repeat purchase until checked.

title: Voucher accepted without credit
content: Record the voucher redemption reference through approved channels and inspect recharge status. Escalate a consumed voucher with no corresponding credit; never ask for payment credentials.

title: Account access recovery
content: Use the official password-reset and identity-verification flow. Check lockout status and recovery contact details. Never ask a customer to reveal a password or one-time code.

title: Account lockout escalation
content: If approved recovery fails, record the lockout error and route to account support. Do not disable verification controls or request a one-time code in support chat.

title: Area outage response
content: Check the official incident notice and impacted service area before asking for router restarts. Share only verified status updates and log the affected service. Escalate unlisted widespread faults.

title: Outage restoration time messaging
content: When an outage is active, do not invent a restoration time. Provide the latest verified update and the next update channel. This draft article awaits operational approval.
